accountDescription: Your HamAlert alerts on the spots board
usernamePostface: Your HamAlert username, usually your callsign
passwordPostface: Your HamAlert password, not the Telnet password
missingCredentials: Enter your HamAlert username and password
loginRefused: HamAlert did not accept that username and password
loginPaused: HamAlert has paused logins for this account after too many failed attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
loginAcceptedNoAppTrigger: Connected as **{{username}}**, but none of your triggers has the **App** action ticked, so no alerts will arrive yet. Tick it on hamalert.org for each trigger you want here.
muteDescription: After you work an alerted station, HamAlert stops alerting it on that band and mode for this long
helpText:
Alerts come from the triggers you set up on [hamalert.org](https://hamalert.org/triggers) that have the **App** action ticked — the same ones HamAlert's own app shows. Each is a spot on the board for an hour, labelled with the trigger's comment. Any spot of that station on that band, from any source, shows a red bell.

Checking for alerts clears the badge in HamAlert's own app, if you use it too.
